answer.tldr: This object is an AdaptiveResponse about Adaptive Response: it was authored by hand and accepted only after AdaptiveResponseSchema.strict() (+ clarify/hybrid superRefine) validated every field.

sections.title: The contract that validated this object
sections.content: AdaptiveResponse is defined once in @adaptive-response/schema (SCHEMA_VERSION 0.1.0). Required roots are decision, answer, and meta. All object schemas use .strict(), so unknown keys fail. decision.mode is answer|clarify|hybrid; confidence is 0–1; ambiguity_level and risk_level are low|medium|high. answer.tldr is always required (1–2 sentences of substance). Optional answer fields: sections[{title,content}], assumptions[], alternatives[{condition,approach}], risks[]. meta.intent_type is informational|analytical|generative|diagnostic|comparative; complexity_score is 0–10. Engine-owned optional meta fields tokens_estimated and schema_version may be stamped after validation.

sections.title: Cross-field rule encoded in this shape
sections.content: When mode is clarify or hybrid, clarifying_questions must be a non-empty array of non-empty strings. That invariant lives in AdaptiveResponseSchema.superRefine and is mirrored in toAdaptiveResponseJsonSchema() as an allOf if/then so the Anthropic tool input_schema cannot drift. This self-description uses mode=answer, so clarifying_questions is omitted — including an empty array would still be valid for answer mode, but the contracted happy path for a confident answer is to leave it absent.

sections.title: How the monorepo enforces the same object everywhere
sections.content: schema → core → api; schema → sdk → ui; demo consumes sdk+ui. core forces Claude to call emit_adaptive_response with input_schema derived from toAdaptiveResponseJsonSchema(), runs safeValidateAdaptiveResponse, allows one repair pass, then stamps tokens_estimated and schema_version. HTTP /v1/respond and MCP /mcp both call the same engine. The SDK re-validates on the client; UI components trust props. This hand-authored instance is the same JSON shape those lanes accept.

sections.title: Why this response is self-referential
sections.content: The subject of answer.tldr and every section is the AdaptiveResponse contract and pipeline. The vehicle is that contract: producing this document required satisfying the schema that the product uses to constrain model output. Dogfooding the schema means the description of Adaptive Response is itself a valid AdaptiveResponse — if the schema rejected this object, the product's source-of-truth claim would be broken for human-authored data too.

assumptions: Readers treat @adaptive-response/schema as the single source of truth (no duplicated AdaptiveResponse types elsewhere).
Policy thresholds (when to choose answer vs clarify vs hybrid, tldr length) live in core's SYSTEM_PROMPT and must stay aligned with schema semantics.
Engine-injected meta fields are stripped from the model-facing tool schema and may be absent on hand-authored instances until the engine stamps them.

alternatives.condition: The query about Adaptive Response were underspecified (e.g. 'is it ready?')
alternatives.approach: Emit mode=clarify or hybrid with non-empty clarifying_questions, still keeping answer.tldr, because AdaptiveResponse always carries an answer object even when routing toward questions.

alternatives.condition: You need the same contract outside TypeScript
alternatives.approach: Call toAdaptiveResponseJsonSchema() and validate against the returned draft-2020-12 JSON Schema, including the allOf clarify/hybrid conditional.

alternatives.condition: You only want in-process generation without the Worker
alternatives.approach: Pass {query, context?} to generateAdaptiveResponse from @adaptive-response/core with an apiKey in config; core never reads env.

risks: Duplicating AdaptiveResponse fields outside @adaptive-response/schema will desync Worker, SDK, and UI from the contract that accepted this object.
Skipping .strict() when extending schemas lets unknown keys through and breaks the model-must-match-contract invariant.
Changing clarify/hybrid policy in SYSTEM_PROMPT without updating superRefine / JSON Schema allOf lets shape and policy drift.
